2. The facts relevant for disposal of the Rule in brief are that on 2-1-2020 one Abdul Mabud Dobash, son of late Abdul Majid Dobash, Firingee Bazar, Police Station-Kotwali, Chattogram filed a Case No. 10 of 2020 under sections 10(2)/12 of the Building Construction Act, 1952 against the accused petitioners alleging, inter alia that the land as stated in the schedule of the petition originally belonged to 1) Abdul Goni and others and BS Khatian No. 107 was duly prepared and published in their names. On 18-7-1994 and other different dates the accused petitioner's father late Mohammad Shafi alias Mohammad Shafi Shawdagor purchased land from the original owners and subsequently heirs of the different owners but in deeds show excess land and the rest of land is owned by Complainant and his co-sharers. The sale deeds of Md. Shafi Shawdagor mentioned in BS Khatian plot Nos. 358 and 359 only whereas he was supposed to get .1122 decimal land under BS Khatian No. 107 corresponding to plot Nos. 350, 351, 355, 356, 357, 358, 359, 360, 361, 365, 366, 370 & 376. His purchased property is not properly measured yet; the father of the accused petitioners created false and fabricated deeds and also created mutation khatian in his favour. On the basis of the fabricated deeds, he got mutation of the complained land along with the excess portion of land which he acquired by way of fraud. The father of the accused petitioners obtained approved layout plan vide Memo No. 460/02/ 2012-2013/324 dated 2-12-2015 to construct a 09 (nine)-storied residential-cum-commercial building along with one semi-basement on the scheduled land hiding actual information and on 5-12-2019 the complainant made a complaint to the Chairman of the Chattogram Unnayan Kartripakkha for cancelling the said layout plan and the Chattogram Unnayan Kartripakkha took cognizance of the complaint and on 12-11-2019 and issued a notice upon the accused petitioners under section 10(2) of the Building Construction Act, 1952 and directed the accused petitioners to submit all the title documents and also directed to stop the construction work but the accused petitioners did not comply the said order and has been continuing the construction works violating the said order and committed offence under section 10(2) of the Building Construction Act, 1952 (as amended 1987); Stating the above facts the Complainant before the Special Magistrate of filed case before the Chattogram Unnayan Kartripakkha which is converted as Emarat Nirman Case being No. 10 of 2020 under section 12(1) of the Building Construction Act, 1952. 

 15. On scanning the materials on record meticulously, it appears that the complaint has been filed by the Complainant Abdul Mabud Dobhash, son of Late Abdul Majid Dobash under sections 10(2)/12 of the Building Construction Act, 1952 against the petitioners alleging inter alia that the father of the accused petitioners created false and fabricated deeds and also created mutation khatian in his favour and on the basis of the fabricated deeds got mutation of the complained land along with the excess portion of land which he acquired by way of practicing fraud. Thereafter, the father of the accused petitioners obtained approved layout plan vide Memo No. 460/02/2012-2013/324 dated 2-12-2015 to construct a 09 (nine) storied residential cum commercial building along with one semi-basement on the schedule land hiding actual information.; on 5-12-2019 the Complainant made the said complaint to the Chairman of the Chattogram Unnayan Kartripakkha for cancelling the said layout plan.
